name: Best AI Brands

sources.title: Homepage — rendered empty to the fetcher; search index describes a curated AI/SaaS/vibe-coded products directory
Submit page — rendered empty to the fetcher; search index shows paid manual-review submission starting at $5 ('buy a coffee')

requirements: AI tool, SaaS product, or 'vibe coded' product — curated directory
Submissions are not free: pricing starts at $5 framed as 'buy 1 coffee'; every submission manually reviewed
Dofollow SEO backlink appears to require a separate email request to hey@bestaibrands.com
preparation: Product name, URL, description, and category
Payment for the ~$5 minimum submission fee
Email draft to hey@bestaibrands.com if a dofollow link is required
workflow: Pay the submission fee (from $5) and fill in the tool details
Manual review follows; approved tools are listed in the directory
watchFor: Homepage meta copy says 'Submit yours for free' while the submit page says 'Submissions are not free' — the $5 minimum appears to be the real policy
Site renders an empty body to automated fetches (JS-only) — submission needs an interactive browser session
Whether the default link is nofollow vs dofollow is unclear — dofollow seems to need a separate email
countsAsLive: The tool has a public listing page on bestaibrands.com reachable from the directory browse pages
unknowns: Exact form fields and payment mechanism (page is JS-rendered)
Full price tiers above the $5 minimum
Whether free submission genuinely exists despite 'not free' copy
